units.title: SG-2.2 · Validated object and world content schema
Act: Add object, scene and world zod schemas
Act: Move the-boys-room content to src/content/worlds and validate in loadWorld
Act: Apply visibleWhen and persistentState in scene view and validator
Verify: Object and world schema unit tests

tests.name: objectSchema > accepts a full valid furniture object inside a scene
tests.title: accepts a full valid furniture object inside a scene
tests.scenario: Given a scene with a fully specified furniture object (layer furniture, position {x:620,y:350}, scale 2, interactionBounds, visibleWhen, persistentState), when parsed as scene content, then ok is true
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/contentSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: objectSchema > rejects an object whose layer is not a known render layer
tests.title: rejects an object whose layer is not a known render layer
tests.scenario: Given an object with layer 'sky', when parsed as scene content, then ok is false and an error path ends with 'layer'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/contentSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: objectSchema > rejects an object that has no position
tests.title: rejects an object that has no position
tests.scenario: Given an object with position omitted, when parsed as scene content, then ok is false and an error path ends with 'position'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/contentSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: objectSchema > defaults scale to 1 when scale is omitted
tests.title: defaults scale to 1 when scale is omitted
tests.scenario: Given an object without scale, when parsed as scene content, then ok is true and data.objects[0].scale is 1
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/contentSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: Relocated the-boys-room content and loader validation unit tests

tests.id: content.test.ts > bedroom content validity > content has no reference errors
tests.name: content has no reference errors
tests.title: bedroom content has no reference errors
tests.scenario: Given the real the-boys-room content, When validated, Then no reference errors are reported

tests.id: content.test.ts > bedroom content validity > opening dialogue text
tests.name: opening dialogue text
tests.title: bedroom opening dialogue text matches the intro line
tests.scenario: Given the real bedroom scene, When the opening dialogue node is looked up, Then its text and speaker match

tests.id: content.test.ts > bedroom content validity > every bedroom object has a layer and position
tests.name: every bedroom object has a layer and position
tests.title: every bedroom object has a layer and position
tests.scenario: Given the real bedroom scene, When objects are read, Then there are six and each has a layer and position

tests.id: content.test.ts > bedroom content validity > has required objects
tests.name: has required objects
tests.title: bedroom scene contains all required objects
tests.scenario: Given the real bedroom scene, When object ids are collected, Then bed, bookshelf, desk, old-computer, window and door are present

tests.id: content.test.ts > bedroom content validity > bookshelf search sets flag
tests.name: bookshelf search sets flag
tests.title: searching the bookshelf sets secret_door_open
tests.scenario: Given the real bedroom scene and initial state, When the bookshelf is searched, Then secret_door_open is true

tests.id: layout.test.ts > game layout > has runtime dirs and no backend/game
tests.name: has runtime dirs and no backend/game
tests.title: game has runtime dirs, the relocated world file, and no content/ or backend/game directory
tests.scenario: Given the game directory, When layout is checked, Then src/content/worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml exists and game/content does not

tests.id: layout.test.ts > game layout > loads the-boys-room from src/content
tests.name: loads the-boys-room from src/content
tests.title: the-boys-room loads from src/content without throwing
tests.scenario: Given the relocated world directory, When loadWorld is called, Then it returns a world

tests.id: loader.test.ts > loadWorld > throws when id is missing
tests.name: throws when id is missing
tests.title: loadWorld throws when world id is missing
tests.scenario: Given a world.yaml without id, When loaded, Then it throws mentioning id
tests.detail: Temp scene fixture now includes title, dialogue and objects.

tests.id: loader.test.ts > loadWorld > throws naming s2.yaml when a listed scene file is missing
tests.name: throws naming s2.yaml when a listed scene file is missing
tests.title: loadWorld names the missing listed scene file s2.yaml
tests.scenario: Given scenes [s, s2] with only s.yaml present, When loaded, Then it throws naming s2.yaml
tests.detail: Previously failed because s.yaml failed schema validation first; fixed by the fixture change.

tests.id: loader.test.ts > loadWorld > throws when a scene file declares a different id than listed
tests.name: throws when a scene file declares a different id than listed
tests.title: loadWorld rejects a scene file whose id differs from the listed id
tests.scenario: Given scene file s.yaml declaring id other, When loaded, Then it throws expected s

tests.id: loader.test.ts > loadWorld > rejects object without position
tests.name: rejects object without position
tests.title: loadWorld rejects a scene object that lacks position
tests.scenario: Given a scene whose object has no position, When loaded, Then it throws a message containing position

tests.name: returns scenes array
tests.title: loadWorld returns the scenes as an array
tests.scenario: Given a valid single-scene world, When loaded, Then scenes is an array whose first id is s
tests.detail: Previously failed on schema validation; fixed by the fixture change.

units.title: Verify: Scene view visibility, persistence and flag validation unit tests

tests.name: getSceneView hides and reveals visibleWhen object
tests.title: hides an object whose visibleWhen flag is unset and shows it once the flag is true
tests.scenario: Given a gated object and flags {}; When flag a is set true; Then the object is absent before and present after

tests.name: getSceneView reports persistentState open toggle
tests.title: reports open false before the persisted flag is set and true after it is set
tests.scenario: Given an object with persistentState flag a and flags {}; When flag a is set; Then open is false before and true after

tests.name: validateWorld flags undeclared persistentState flag
tests.title: returns an unknown flag error when persistentState references a flag not declared by the world
tests.scenario: Given a world whose object has persistentState flag zzz not in world.flags; When validated; Then errors contain 'unknown flag: zzz'
